question: Find the single equivalent discount (rounded off to two decimal places) for successive discounts of 16%, 29% and 4%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equivalent discount = 1 − (1−0.16)(1−0.29)(1−0.04)

= 1 − (0.84 × 0.71 × 0.96)

= 1 − 0.572544 = 0.427456

= 42.75%

**∴ Answer = 42.75%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive discounts = 16%, 29%, 4%

**Formula used:**

Net factor = (1 − d₁)(1 − d₂)(1 − d₃)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Remaining price = 0.84 × 0.71 × 0.96

⇒ = 0.572544

⇒ Equivalent discount = 1 − 0.572544

⇒ = 0.427456

⇒ = 42.75%

**∴ The correct answer is 42.75%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Rule

Equivalent discount = 1 − product of remaining fractions.

Shortcut Tip

Convert % to decimals for quick multiplication.

Approximation

Round final answer to required decimal places.
